title: Gemini Dollar launch context
description: Gemini Dollar was launched as a Gemini-issued USD stablecoin. SOG records this as launch, issuer, reserve-attestation, and Ethereum deployment context.

title: Liquity V1 and LUSD lifecycle context
description: Liquity introduced LUSD as part of its crypto-collateralized borrowing protocol. SOG records this as protocol lifecycle context, separate from later Liquity V2 and BOLD treatment.
notes: PR-038 event expansion. Exact launch-date source should be strengthened later.

title: crvUSD launch and LLAMMA context
description: Curve crvUSD entered the market as a Curve protocol stablecoin with LLAMMA and collateral-specific mechanics. SOG records this as protocol lifecycle context.

title: Ethena USDe launches publicly
description: Ethena Labs marked 19 February 2024 as USDe’s official public launch.
notes: Official public-launch evidence replaces the earlier approximate 2024-02-01 context date.

title: sUSD and Synthetix protocol lifecycle context

title: Frax launch context
description: Frax entered operation as a USD-pegged protocol stablecoin. SOG records this as the starting point for FRAX collateral, AMO, governance, and non-redeemability lifecycle context.
notes: Uses the canonical launch date and existing Frax primary documentation.

title: TrueUSD launch context
description: TrueUSD entered the market as a USD-backed stablecoin. SOG records this as the starting point for issuer, reserve-attestation, redemption, and multichain lifecycle context.
notes: Uses the canonical launch date and existing TrueUSD primary sources.

title: Ripple USD launches globally
description: Ripple made RLUSD available on global exchanges beginning December 17, 2024. SOG records this as the product launch date while keeping issuer, reserve-attestation, legal-terms, and deployment context as separate layers.
notes: Official Ripple launch announcement added in launch-date Batch L; the legacy event ID is retained for reference stability.

title: Euro Coin launches on Ethereum
description: Circle launched its euro-backed stablecoin on Ethereum on June 30, 2022 under the Euro Coin / EUROC name. SOG treats the later EURC name and symbol as the same continuous asset identity.
notes: Official Circle launch announcement added in launch-date Batch L; the legacy event ID is retained for reference stability.

title: Global Dollar launch context
description: Global Dollar entered operation within the Global Dollar Network and Paxos-related issuer structure. SOG records this as launch, backing, redemption, partner-network, and unresolved deployment context.
